Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Kris Dunn?

Kris Dunn is 32 years old.

Where was Kris Dunn born?

Kris Dunn was born in New London, Connecticut.

When was Kris Dunn born?

Kris Dunn was born on March 18, 1994.

How tall is Kris Dunn?

Kris Dunn is 6-3 (190 cm) tall.

How much does Kris Dunn weigh?

Kris Dunn weighs 205 lbs (92 kg).

Is Kris Dunn in the Hall of Fame?

Kris Dunn is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Kris Dunn drafted?

Kris Dunn was drafted by Minnesota Timberwolves, 1st round (5th pick, 5th overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position does Kris Dunn play?

Point Guard.

What is Kris Dunn's net worth?

Kris Dunn has made at least $41,700,644 playing professional basketball.

How much does Kris Dunn make?

Kris Dunn made $5,426,400 in 2026.

How many rings does Kris Dunn have?

Kris Dunn has won 0 championships.

What is Kris Dunn's Instagram account?

Kris Dunn is on Instagram at krisdunn3.

What schools did Kris Dunn attend?

Kris Dunn attended New London in New London, Connecticut and Providence.

What are Kris Dunn's nicknames?

The Dunngeon is a nickname for Kris Dunn.
